REAL-TIME TIMING WINDOW [0 µs to 35,000 µs]:
Even under maximum clock jitter and physical subcarrier antenna delay,
execution completes with 6.5 ms headroom before the next RF poll window.
All 9 vertices sequentially verified without preemption or task deadlock.
Slack = 35,000 µs - 28,500 µs = +6,500 µs (+18.57% safety margin).
Defends against UID-spoofing and cloned cards via Sector 1 Key A.
Compared to unauthenticated Level 1 UID polling (~2.8 ms), authenticated
Level 2 reads guarantee cryptographic transponder ownership in 28.5 ms.
Any failure at D1 (FIFO), D2 (Crypto-1), or D3 (CRC) routes directly to
BB_FAULT/F1 within 200 µs, preventing invalid buffer propagation.
